findings.evidence: Lines 169-171; `Matrix.PosSemidef` is the `Finsupp.sum` definition (`mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/PosDef.lean:60-61`), and `map_finsuppSum` exists at this pin.
findings.fix: Push `RCLike.re` through the sums with `map_finsuppSum` (Mathlib, e.g. used at `mathlib/Mathlib/Basic/NNReal/Basic.lean:86`) applied to the bundled `RCLike.re`, so `Finsupp.sum` is never unfolded, and drop the matching `Finsupp.sum` from the closing `simpa only`.
findings.issue: `simp only [Finsupp.sum, map_sum, ...] at h` unfolds `Finsupp.sum` to a `Finset.sum` only so that `map_sum` fires, and line 171 refolds it with `simpa only [Finsupp.sum, map_apply, star_trivial]`. The terse `simpa` then closes a non-obvious goal out of this unfolded context, so the proof is brittle against any change to `Finsupp.sum`'s equation lemmas.

findings.evidence: Lines 162-168: one comment covers the whole branch; `(by simp)` appears at 163, 165 and in the `mapRange` term inside `key`.
findings.fix: Introduce the vector once (`set y : n →₀ 𝕜 := x.mapRange ((↑) : ℝ → 𝕜) RCLike.ofReal_zero`, using the named lemma at `mathlib/Mathlib/Analysis/RCLike/Basic.lean:143`) and add a one-line comment that `h` is nonnegativity of `re (yᴴ M y)` and that the two `sum_mapRange_index` steps strip the coercion from the outer then the inner `Finsupp.sum`.
findings.issue: `x.mapRange ((↑) : ℝ → 𝕜) (by simp)` is repeated three times (lines 163, 165) with an anonymous tactic proof of the zero condition, and the helper `key` is stated with a free `b : ℝ` purely so `simp only [key]` can rewrite the inner sum — nothing says that the two `Finsupp.sum_mapRange_index` applications are the outer and inner sum, nor why `(RCLike.nonneg_iff.mp …).1` is the right projection.

findings.fix: Collapse to a single automation step seeded with the one non-simp fact, e.g. `simpa [map_apply, RCLike.star_def] using congrArg RCLike.re (hM.isHermitian.apply i j)`.
findings.issue: The Hermitian field is proved by a six-lemma `rw` chain (`map_apply, map_apply, star_trivial, ← hM.isHermitian.apply i j, RCLike.star_def, RCLike.conj_re`); four of these are ordinary simp lemmas, so the chain breaks on any upstream rename or restatement of `RCLike.star_def`/`RCLike.conj_re`.

summary: The dipole amplitude proofs are robust and readable, but the new `Matrix.PosSemidef.map_re` closes its quadratic-form goal by unfolding and refolding `Finsupp.sum` under `simp only`/`simpa only`, with an unexplained `key` rewrite and three inline `(by simp)` coercion-zero proofs. Fix that proof's structure; the rest of the PR is fine from this angle.
